subject: Reminder: VA - National Office Supply Program - MRAS
snippet: Dear GSA Industry Partner: Link to the RFI: Take the survey This a REMINDER about a recently posted MRAS RFI that your company was identified as a GSA Contractor that can potentially meet the needs of
requirement_summary: VA seeks a National Office Supply Program (BOC 2620/2625) with a contractor-managed, VA-governed ordering portal: catalog governance, EDI transactions, approval workflows, mandatory-source compliance, supplier coordination, delivery to VA-approved points, reporting, and help desk support VA-wide.
